Name: Rubble Muddle
Overview:
Rubble Muddle is a brand new game for the App Store providing an innovative and explosive twist for the classic 2D matrix puzzle genre. In Rubble Muddle, you have to shift and detonate your way through ever changing heaps of rocks in order to bag the valuable mixed up jewels and prizes. The frenetic pace and unique ability to skilfully move the rocks into bigger clusters before blasting them for maximum points, makes Rubble Muddle stand out as being one of the most compelling puzzle games yet to be released in 2010.

As the rubble relentlessly piles down from above, the aim of each level is to dynamite your way through all the rocks in a limited time and collect as many jewel points as possible along the way. This is accomplished by simply touching blocks of the same type then blowing them up with a second hit. Blocks must be along side at least one of the same type for them to be removed, so an addictive mix of agility and strategy comes into play as you re-arrange the rocks to set up bigger and better combos. Your score increases as you explode rocks and bag more and more precious jewels. If enough rubble is cleared and you have collected a booty of jewels before the time runs out, a tunnel door is uncovered, and you can move in to tackle the next level.

• 16 different levels plus 3 difficulty settings - each with a high score table.
• Dozens of rocks and jewels to detonate and collect including Granite, Iron ore, Pumice, Diamonds and Emeralds.
• Exciting Bonus items to collect – Find the special Bonus to randomly remove all of one block type from the screen, or destroy all nearby blocks with the powerful Big Bomb Explosion!
• Block control: Finger click ‘scaled on touch’ or blocks moved laterally across screen.
• Special effects: Explosions, twinkle animation, timer, screen shaking, spinning question marks for a ‘Mystery’ bonus - all add stunning visual impact to game play.
• Original music composition and Stereo Sound FX.
• Game Save or Pause to play later or with friends.

Manic, explosive, mentally challenging and fun, Rubble Muddle is a thrilling race against the clock when played alone or against other gamers - and a seriously addictive experience for both the casual and hardcore gamer alike. As you move up the difficulty settings, your strategic thinking and visual reaction will be tested to the extreme.
